metadata.label: Ontario Science and Technology Grade 2 curriculum

ontario-science-g2-all-strands.documentTitle: Ontario Science and Technology Grade 2 - Overall Expectations

standards.summaryText: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures
standards.officialOutcomeText: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures

standards.summaryText: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life
standards.officialOutcomeText: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences

standards.summaryText: assess ways in which animals have an impact on society and the environment, and ways in which human activities have an impact on animals and the places where they live
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess ways in which animals have an impact on society and the environment, and ways in which human activities have an impact on animals and the places where they live
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding that animals grow and change and have distinct characteristics
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding that animals grow and change and have distinct characteristics

standards.summaryText: assess ways in which liquids and solids and their uses can have an impact on society and the environment
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess ways in which liquids and solids and their uses can have an impact on society and the environment
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the properties and physical changes of liquids and solids
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the properties and physical changes of liquids and solids

standards.summaryText: assess the impact of simple machines on society and on the environment
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess the impact of simple machines on society and on the environment
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of movement and ways in which simple machines help to move objects
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of movement and ways in which simple machines help to move objects

standards.summaryText: assess ways in which the actions of humans have an impact on the quality of air and water, and create plans to protect these resources
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess ways in which the actions of humans have an impact on the quality of air and water, and create plans to protect these resources
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the properties of air and water, including water in various states, and of ways in which living things depend on air and water for their survival
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the properties of air and water, including water in various states, and of ways in which living things depend on air and water for their survival
